answer: The vote weight of a falcon is the square of its plume, one plume minted per consecutive epoch it passes a randomly assigned graded audit, untransferable and zeroed by any missed epoch. The hollow stores the audit transcripts of every falcon, so clones giving correlated answers collide there and lose all plume. One honest falcon reaches weight 10,000 after 100 epochs; 1,000 fresh clones hold only 1,000 combined, and catching up costs each head 100 elapsed epochs of distinct audited work. It breaks if audits are cheaply passed or transcripts decorrelated.
